words.gloss: devoted to austerity and Vedic study
of those who know speech, the eloquent
bull among sages, best of sages

hindi: तपस्वी वाल्मीकि ने तप और स्वाध्याय में निरत, वाणी के ज्ञाताओं में श्रेष्ठ, मुनियों में श्रेष्ठ नारद से पूछा।
english: The ascetic Vālmīki asked Nārada, who was devoted to austerity and Vedic study, best among the eloquent, a bull among sages.
notes: All of tapaḥsvādhyāyanirataṃ, vāgvidāṃ varam and munipuṅgavam qualify Nārada (acc.); tapasvī qualifies Vālmīki (nom.).

hindi: इस समय इस लोक में कौन गुणवान् है, और कौन वीर्यवान्? कौन धर्म को जानने वाला, कृतज्ञ, सत्यवादी और दृढ़व्रत है?
english: Who now in this world is endowed with virtues, and who is valorous? Who knows dharma, is grateful, true in speech and firm in vows?
lines_deva: को न्वस्मिन् साम्प्रतं लोके गुणवान् कश्च वीर्यवान्
lines_iast: ko nvasmin sāmprataṃ loke guṇavān kaśca vīryavān

hindi: कौन सदाचार से युक्त है, कौन सब प्राणियों का हितैषी है? कौन विद्वान् है, कौन समर्थ है, और कौन एकमात्र प्रियदर्शन है?
english: Who is endowed with good conduct, who is well-disposed to all beings? Who is learned, who is capable, and who alone is pleasing to behold?
notes: eka-priya-darśana: 'eka' may mean 'uniquely' (the one whose sight is pleasing) or 'uniformly' (pleasing to all alike); rendered 'alone pleasing to behold'. The repeated 'kaḥ kaḥ' are two separate questions (learned? capable?).
lines_deva: चारित्रेण च को युक्तः सर्वभूतेषु को हितः
lines_iast: cāritreṇa ca ko yuktaḥ sarvabhūteṣu ko hitaḥ

hindi: कौन आत्मवान् है, किसने क्रोध को जीत लिया है, कौन बुद्धिमान् है, कौन ईर्ष्या से रहित है? युद्ध में क्रोध होने पर किससे देवता भी डरते हैं?
english: Who is self-possessed, who has conquered anger, who is intelligent, who is free from envy? Of whom are even the gods afraid when his anger is roused in battle?
notes: bibhyati takes the genitive (kasya ... jātaroṣasya) for the object of fear.

hindi: यह मैं सुनना चाहता हूँ, क्योंकि मुझे इसका बड़ा कौतूहल है। हे महर्षि, ऐसे मनुष्य को जानने में आप समर्थ हैं।
english: This I wish to hear, for my curiosity is great. O great sage, you are able to know such a man.
lines_deva: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे
lines_iast: etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me

hindi: और वाल्मीकि के इस वचन को सुनकर, तीनों लोकों को जानने वाले नारद ने "सुनिए" ऐसा कहकर, प्रसन्न होकर यह वाक्य कहा।
english: And having heard these words of Vālmīki, Nārada, knower of the three worlds, addressed him with "Let it be heard" and, delighted, spoke these words.

hindi: हे मुनि, आपने जिन गुणों का वर्णन किया है, वे अनेक हैं और दुर्लभ भी हैं। मैं विचार करके कहूँगा; उन गुणों से युक्त मनुष्य के विषय में सुनिए।
english: O sage, the virtues you have enumerated are many and hard to find indeed. Having considered, I shall tell you; let the man who is endowed with them be heard of.
lines_deva: बहवो दुर्लभाश्चैव ये त्वया कीर्तिता गुणाः
मुने वक्ष्याम्यहं बुद्ध्वा तैर्युक्तः श्रूयतां नरः
lines_iast: bahavo durlabhāścaiva ye tvayā kīrtitā guṇāḥ
mune vakṣyāmyahaṃ buddhvā tairyuktaḥ śrūyatāṃ naraḥ

words.gloss: born in the lineage of Ikṣvāku

hindi: इक्ष्वाकु वंश में उत्पन्न, लोगों में राम नाम से प्रसिद्ध, वह नियतात्मा, महापराक्रमी, कान्तिमान्, धैर्यवान् और जितेन्द्रिय है।
english: Born in the lineage of Ikṣvāku, known among people by the name Rāma, he is of controlled self, of great valour, radiant, steadfast and self-controlled.

words.gloss: with a neck like a conch

hindi: वह बुद्धिमान्, नीतिमान्, वाग्मी, श्रीमान्, शत्रुओं का नाश करने वाला, चौड़े कंधों वाला, महाबाहु, शंख के समान ग्रीवा वाला और बड़े जबड़े वाला है।
english: He is wise, versed in policy, eloquent, glorious, a destroyer of enemies, broad-shouldered, mighty-armed, with a neck like a conch and strong jaws.

words.gloss: of fine stride, of great prowess

hindi: वह विशाल वक्ष वाला, महान् धनुर्धर, छिपी हुई हँसली वाला, शत्रुओं का दमन करने वाला, घुटनों तक लम्बी भुजाओं वाला, सुन्दर सिर वाला, सुन्दर ललाट वाला और सुन्दर पराक्रम वाला है।
english: He is broad-chested, a great bowman, with hidden collar-bones, a tamer of foes, with arms reaching to his knees, a fine head, a fine forehead and a fine stride.
notes: suvikrama: vikrama is both 'stride, gait' and 'prowess'; rendered 'fine stride' in the list of bodily features.

hindi: वह सुडौल, समान रूप से विभक्त अंगों वाला, स्निग्ध वर्ण वाला, प्रतापी, पुष्ट वक्ष वाला, विशाल नेत्रों वाला, लक्ष्मी से युक्त और शुभ लक्षणों वाला है।
english: He is well-proportioned, with evenly formed limbs, of glossy complexion, majestic, full-chested, large-eyed, endowed with splendour and bearing auspicious marks.

hindi: वह धर्म को जानने वाला, सत्यप्रतिज्ञ, प्रजा के हित में रत, यशस्वी, ज्ञान से सम्पन्न, पवित्र, विनयशील और समाधिमान् है।
english: He knows dharma, is true to his word, devoted to the welfare of the people, renowned, endowed with knowledge, pure, amenable and of concentrated mind.
notes: vaśya: 'amenable, submissive (to guidance)'; Hindi gives विनयशील.
lines_deva: धर्मज्ञः सत्यसन्धश्च प्रजानां च हिते रतः
lines_iast: dharmajñaḥ satyasandhaśca prajānāṃ ca hite rataḥ

words.gloss: of the world of living beings
knower of the essence of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas

hindi: वह जीवलोक का रक्षक, धर्म का परिरक्षक, वेद और वेदांगों के तत्त्व को जानने वाला और धनुर्वेद में निष्णात है।
english: He is the protector of the world of living beings, the guardian of dharma, knower of the essence of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, and accomplished in the science of archery.

words.gloss: knower of the essence of the meaning of all śāstras

hindi: वह सब शास्त्रों के अर्थ के तत्त्व को जानने वाला, स्मृतिमान्, प्रतिभाशाली, सब लोगों का प्रिय, साधु, अदीन आत्मा वाला और विचक्षण है।
english: He knows the essence of the meaning of all the śāstras, has a good memory, is quick-witted, dear to all people, virtuous, of undejected spirit and discerning.

text_flags.why: possible: before smṛtimān (s-) the visarga should remain (-jñaḥ smṛtimān); -o is irregular sandhi, either ārṣa or a typo; the Devanagari has the same -ो

hindi: जैसे नदियाँ समुद्र के पास आती हैं, वैसे ही सज्जन सदा उसके पास आते हैं। वह आर्य है, सबके प्रति समान है और सदा एक समान प्रियदर्शन है।
english: He is always resorted to by the good, as the ocean by rivers; he is noble, equal towards all, and ever of uniformly pleasing appearance.
notes: eka-priya-darśana as in verse 3; here with sadā the sense 'always the same pleasing sight' fits best.

hindi: और वह सब गुणों से युक्त, कौसल्या के आनन्द को बढ़ाने वाला, गम्भीरता में समुद्र के समान और धैर्य में हिमालय के समान है।
english: And he, endowed with all virtues, the increaser of Kausalyā's joy, is like the ocean in depth and like the Himavat in steadfastness.

hindi: वह वीर्य में विष्णु के समान, चन्द्रमा के समान प्रियदर्शन, क्रोध में कालाग्नि के समान और क्षमा में पृथ्वी के समान है।
english: In valour he is like Viṣṇu, pleasing to behold like the moon, like the fire of doom in anger, and equal to the earth in forbearance.

words.gloss: with Dhanada, the giver of wealth

hindi: वह दान में धनद के समान और सत्य में मानो दूसरा धर्म है। ऐसे गुणों से सम्पन्न, सत्यपराक्रमी उस राम को —
english: In giving he is equal to Dhanada, and in truth like a second Dharma. That Rāma, endowed with such virtues, of true valour —
notes: Second line is the object of the sentence completed in verse 19 (Daśaratha wished to invest him). Dhanada 'giver of wealth' is an epithet; the line does not name whose.

hindi: उस ज्येष्ठ, श्रेष्ठ गुणों से युक्त, प्रिय पुत्र को महीपति दशरथ ने प्रेमपूर्वक युवराज के पद से युक्त करने की इच्छा की।
english: Daśaratha, lord of the earth, wished out of affection to invest that eldest son, endowed with the best virtues and dear to him, with the office of heir-apparent.
notes: Completes the sentence begun in verse 18 (tam ... rāmaṃ).

words.gloss: who had been granted a boon

hindi: उसके अभिषेक की तैयारियों को देखकर, जिसे पहले वर दिया गया था, उस पत्नी देवी कैकयी ने तब यह वर माँगा — राम का वनवास और भरत का अभिषेक।
english: Seeing the preparations for his consecration, his wife, Queen Kaikayī, who had formerly been granted a boon, then asked for this boon: the banishment of Rāma and the consecration of Bharata.
notes: Name spelt kaikayī here and kaikeyyāḥ in verse 22; both forms are attested, so not flagged. Three lines form one numbered verse (a, b, c).

hindi: सत्यवचन के कारण धर्म के पाश से बँधे हुए उस राजा दशरथ ने अपने प्रिय पुत्र राम को वनवास दे दिया।
english: That king Daśaratha, bound by the noose of dharma because of his true word, banished his dear son Rāma.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. caus. anu-√pā

words.gloss: by the command of the word

hindi: वह वीर पिता के वचन के आदेश से और कैकेयी को प्रसन्न करने के लिए, प्रतिज्ञा का पालन करता हुआ, वन को चला गया।
english: That hero went to the forest, honouring the promise, by the command of his father's word and for the sake of pleasing Kaikeyī.

hindi: जाते हुए उसके पीछे, स्नेह के कारण, विनय से सम्पन्न, सुमित्रा के आनन्द को बढ़ाने वाला प्रिय भाई लक्ष्मण चल पड़ा।
english: As he went, his dear brother Lakṣmaṇa, endowed with modesty, the increaser of Sumitrā's joy, followed him out of affection.
lines_deva: तं व्रजन्तं प्रियो भ्राता लक्ष्मणोऽनुजगाम ह
lines_iast: taṃ vrajantaṃ priyo bhrātā lakṣmaṇo'nujagāma ha

hindi: सब लक्षणों से सम्पन्न, नारियों में उत्तम वधू सीता भी राम के पीछे वैसे ही चली, जैसे रोहिणी चन्द्रमा के पीछे।
english: Sītā too, his wife, endowed with all auspicious marks, the best of women, followed Rāma as Rohiṇī follows the moon.

words.gloss: on the bank of the Gaṅgā

hindi: नगरवासियों और पिता दशरथ के द्वारा दूर तक अनुगमन किए जाने पर, उसने शृंगवेरपुर में गंगा के तट पर सारथि को विदा कर दिया।
english: Followed far by the citizens and by his father Daśaratha, he dismissed the charioteer at Śṛṅgaverapura on the bank of the Gaṅgā.

hindi: वे वन से वन में जाकर, बहुत जल वाली नदियों को पार करके, भरद्वाज के आदेश से चित्रकूट पहुँचे।
english: Going from forest to forest and crossing rivers abounding in water, they reached Citrakūṭa at the instruction of Bharadvāja.
notes: vanena vanaṃ gatvā: idiom 'going from forest to forest'. The absolutives continue into verse 27, where the main verb (nyavasan) stands.
lines_deva: ते वनेन वनं गत्वा नदीस्तीर्त्वा बहूदकाः
lines_iast: te vanena vanaṃ gatvā nadīstīrtvā bahūdakāḥ

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. ātm. √ram

hindi: वहाँ रमणीय आवास बनाकर, वन में आनन्द से विहार करते हुए, देवताओं और गन्धर्वों के समान वे तीनों सुखपूर्वक रहने लगे।
english: Having made a delightful dwelling there, the three of them, enjoying themselves in the forest, resembling gods and gandharvas, lived happily.

words.gloss: afflicted by grief for his son

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. vi-√lap

hindi: राम के चित्रकूट चले जाने पर, पुत्र के शोक से आतुर राजा दशरथ तब पुत्र के लिए विलाप करते हुए स्वर्ग सिधार गए।
english: When Rāma had gone to Citrakūṭa, King Daśaratha, afflicted with grief for his son, then went to heaven lamenting his son.
lines_deva: राजा दशरथः स्वर्गं जगाम विलपन् सुतम्
lines_iast: rājā daśarathaḥ svargaṃ jagāma vilapan sutam

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. pass. part. ni-√yuj

words.gloss: seeking the favour of Rāma's feet

hindi: उसके मरने पर वसिष्ठ आदि द्विजों द्वारा राज्य के लिए नियुक्त किए जाते हुए महाबली भरत ने राज्य की इच्छा नहीं की। वह वीर राम के चरणों को प्रसन्न करने के लिए वन को गया।
english: And when he had died, the mighty Bharata, being urged by the brahmins headed by Vasiṣṭha to take the kingship, did not desire the kingdom; that hero went to the forest to seek the favour of Rāma's feet.
notes: Three lines form one numbered verse (a, b, c).

hindi: और भरत के बड़े भाई ने राज्य के लिए अपनी दोनों पादुकाएँ धरोहर के रूप में देकर, तब बार-बार भरत को वापस लौटाया।
english: And having given his two sandals as a trust for the kingdom, Bharata's elder brother then, again and again, turned Bharata back.
notes: punaḥ punaḥ 'again and again' goes with nivartayāmāsa (repeated insistence that Bharata return); asya 'his' = Rāma's own sandals. asya may also be the genitive of the recipient (Bharata): 'having given the sandals to him as a trust for the kingdom'; the line does not decide.
lines_deva: पादुके चास्य राज्याय न्यासं दत्त्वा पुनः पुनः
lines_iast: pāduke cāsya rājyāya nyāsaṃ dattvā punaḥ punaḥ

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. upa-√spṛś

hindi: अपनी कामना को पूरा न कर पाकर भी, राम के चरणों का स्पर्श करता हुआ वह राम के आगमन की आकांक्षा से नन्दिग्राम में राज्य करने लगा।
english: Even without obtaining his wish, touching Rāma's feet, he carried on the rule from Nandigrāma, longing for Rāma's return.
notes: rāmapādau 'Rāma's feet' here refers to the sandals of verse 30; translated literally.

hindi: किन्तु राम नगर के लोगों का वहाँ फिर आना देखकर, एकाग्र चित्त से दण्डक वन में प्रविष्ट हुए।
english: But Rāma, foreseeing that the people of the city would come there again, single-mindedly entered the Daṇḍaka forest.

text_flags.why: possible: ekāgre (loc.) agrees with nothing in the sentence; ekāgraḥ (nom., qualifying Rāma) gives the expected sense 'resolute'; metre is unaffected either way

notes: If ekāgre is kept, it could only be read adverbially ('with concentration'); the translation follows the nom. reading. 'punaḥ' may go with ālakṣya ('again observing') or with āgamanam ('coming again'); rendered with āgamanam.

hindi: राक्षस विराध को मारकर उसने शरभंग को देखा, तथा सुतीक्ष्ण को, अगस्त्य को और अगस्त्य के भाई को भी।
english: Having killed the rākṣasa Virādha, he saw Śarabhaṅga, and also Sutīkṣṇa, Agastya and likewise Agastya's brother.

text_flags.why: possible: 'agastya' stands as a bare stem; it is the first member of the compound agastya-bhrātaraṃ, which is normally printed as one word

notes: 'ca agastya' is left without sandhi (hiatus) in the text; kept as printed.
lines_deva: विराधं राक्षसं हत्वा शरभङ्गं ददर्श ह
सुतीक्ष्णं चाप्यगस्त्यं च अगस्त्य भ्रातरं तथा
lines_iast: virādhaṃ rākṣasaṃ hatvā śarabhaṅgaṃ dadarśa ha
sutīkṣṇaṃ cāpyagastyaṃ ca agastya bhrātaraṃ tathā

hindi: और अगस्त्य के वचन से ही उसने परम प्रसन्न होकर इन्द्र का धनुष, खड्ग और अक्षय बाणों वाले दो तूणीर ग्रहण किए।
english: And at Agastya's word, greatly pleased, he received Indra's bow, a sword, and two quivers with inexhaustible arrows.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. √vas (gen. abs.)

hindi: उस राम के वन में वनचरों के साथ रहते हुए, सब ऋषि असुरों और राक्षसों के वध के लिए उसके पास आए।
english: While that Rāma was dwelling in the forest with the forest-dwellers, all the sages came to him for the slaying of the asuras and rākṣasas.
notes: vasatas tasya rāmasya: genitive absolute. abhyāgaman: augmented 3 pl. (aorist, or impf. of a root-class form); tag given as aorist.

words.gram: f. nom. sg. ppp. caus. vi-√rūp

words.gloss: able to take any form at will

hindi: वहीं रहते हुए उसके द्वारा जनस्थान में निवास करने वाली, इच्छानुसार रूप धारण करने वाली राक्षसी शूर्पणखा विरूपित की गई।
english: By him, while dwelling right there, the rākṣasī Śūrpaṇakhā, who lived in Janasthāna and could take any form at will, was disfigured.

hindi: तब शूर्पणखा के वचन से उद्यत हुए सब राक्षसों को — खर, त्रिशिरा और राक्षस दूषण को भी —
english: Then all the rākṣasas roused by Śūrpaṇakhā's words, Khara, Triśiras and the rākṣasa Dūṣaṇa too —
notes: Accusatives are the objects of nijaghāna in verse 38; sentence completed there.
lines_deva: खरं त्रिशिरसं चैव दूषणं चैव राक्षसं
lines_iast: kharaṃ triśirasaṃ caiva dūṣaṇaṃ caiva rākṣasaṃ

hindi: उन्हें और उनके अनुचरों को भी राम ने युद्ध में मार डाला; चौदह हजार राक्षस मारे गए।
english: Rāma slew them in battle, and their followers too; fourteen thousand rākṣasas were slain.
notes: Completes the sentence begun in verse 37.

hindi: तब अपने बन्धुओं के वध को सुनकर क्रोध से मूर्छित रावण ने मारीच नामक राक्षस को सहायक के रूप में चुना।
english: Then, hearing of the slaying of his kinsmen, Rāvaṇa, beside himself with anger, chose as his helper a rākṣasa named Mārīca.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. pass. part. caus. √vṛ

hindi: मारीच द्वारा वह रावण बहुत बार रोका गया — "हे रावण, उस बलवान् के साथ विरोध तुम्हारे लिए उचित नहीं है।"
english: That Rāvaṇa was dissuaded very many times by Mārīca: "O Rāvaṇa, enmity with him, that mighty one, is not advisable for you."
notes: Second line is Mārīca's direct speech (no iti in this verse). The sentence about Rāvaṇa (vāryamāṇaḥ ... sa rāvaṇaḥ) is completed in the next verse, outside this chunk.
lines_deva: न विरोधो बलवता क्षमो रावण तेन ते
lines_iast: na virodho balavatā kṣamo rāvaṇa tena te

hindi: किन्तु काल से प्रेरित रावण ने उन वचनों की अवहेलना करके मारीच के साथ तब उसके आश्रम-स्थान को प्रस्थान किया।
english: But Rāvaṇa, impelled by fate, disregarding those words, then went together with Mārīca to his hermitage.
notes: tasya 'his' refers to the person whose hermitage it is (not named in this verse); kāla may be 'time' or 'fate/death'.

hindi: उस मायावी के द्वारा दोनों राजकुमारों को दूर हटवाकर, उसने जटायु गृध्र को मारकर राम की भार्या का हरण किया।
english: Having had the two princes drawn far away by that master of illusion, he carried off Rāma's wife, after killing the vulture Jaṭāyus.
notes: apavāhya with tena māyāvinā: the leading-away is done through the illusionist; the subject (he) is Rāvaṇa from the previous verse.
lines_deva: जहार भार्यां रामस्य गृध्रं हत्वा जटायुषम्
lines_iast: jahāra bhāryāṃ rāmasya gṛdhraṃ hatvā jaṭāyuṣam

hindi: गृध्र को मारा हुआ देखकर और मैथिली का हरण सुनकर, शोक से संतप्त राघव व्याकुल इन्द्रियों वाले होकर विलाप करने लगे।
english: Seeing the vulture slain and hearing that the princess of Mithilā had been carried off, the Rāghava, burning with grief, his senses in turmoil, lamented.
lines_deva: गृध्रं च निहतं दृष्ट्वा हृतां श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम्
lines_iast: gṛdhraṃ ca nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛtāṃ śrutvā ca maithilīm

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. ātm. √mārg

hindi: तब उसी शोक में जटायु गृध्र का दाह करके, वन में सीता को खोजते हुए उन्होंने एक राक्षस को देखा।
english: Then, in that same grief, having cremated the vulture Jaṭāyus, while searching the forest for Sītā he saw a rākṣasa.
lines_deva: मार्गमाणो वने सीतां राक्षसं सन्ददर्श ह
lines_iast: mārgamāṇo vane sītāṃ rākṣasaṃ sandadarśa ha

hindi: कबन्ध नामक, रूप से विकृत और घोर दर्शन वाले उसको मारकर महाबाहु ने उसे जलाया, और वह स्वर्ग चला गया।
english: The mighty-armed one, having slain him, Kabandha by name, deformed in form and dreadful to behold, cremated him; and he went to heaven.
notes: 'svargataś ca saḥ': the one who went to heaven is the slain Kabandha, not the slayer (the subject of nihatya/dadāha).

hindi: और उसने उनसे कहा — "हे राघव, धर्म का आचरण करने वाली, धर्म में निपुण श्रमणी शबरी के पास जाओ।" वे महातेजस्वी शत्रुसूदन शबरी के पास गए।
english: And he told him: "O Rāghava, go to Śabarī, the woman ascetic who practises dharma and is skilled in dharma." He, the destroyer of enemies, of great splendour, went to Śabarī.
notes: Three-line unit as in the edition. 'sa' (he who told) is the one cremated in the previous verse, by context; the line itself does not name him.

words.gloss: on the bank of the Pampā

hindi: शबरी के द्वारा भली-भाँति पूजित दशरथ-पुत्र राम पम्पा के तट पर हनुमान् वानर से मिले।
english: Rāma, son of Daśaratha, duly honoured by Śabarī, met the monkey Hanumat on the bank of the Pampā.

hindi: और हनुमान् के वचन से ही वे सुग्रीव से मिले, और महाबली राम ने सुग्रीव को वह सब कह सुनाया।
english: And at Hanumat's word indeed he met with Sugrīva; and Rāma of great strength told Sugrīva all that.
notes: śaṃsat taken as an augmentless imperfect (epic usage) = aśaṃsat 'told'; as a present participle the nom. sg. would be śaṃsan, so the finite reading is preferred.

words.gram: n. nom. sg., ppp caus. ā-√vid
m. inst. sg., ppp denom. duḥkhaya- (duḥkha + ita)

hindi: तब दुःखी वानरराज ने प्रेमवश वैर की पूरी कथा राम को निवेदित की, और वहाँ उस वानर ने वालि का बल भी बताया।
english: Then the king of the monkeys, grieved, out of affection made known to Rāma everything concerning the tale of the enmity; and there the monkey told of Vālin's strength.
notes: Three-line unit as in the edition. 'vairānukathanaṃ prati' = with regard to the narration of the feud; the feud's parties are not named in this verse.

hindi: और राम ने तब वालि-वध के विषय में प्रतिज्ञा की; और सुग्रीव राघव के पराक्रम के विषय में निरन्तर शंकित रहा।
english: And Rāma then made a promise concerning the slaying of Vālin; and Sugrīva was constantly doubtful about the prowess in the Rāghava.
notes: 'vīryeṇa rāghave' = doubtful as to (the) prowess in the Rāghava, i.e. whether Rāghava had the strength; literal rendering kept.
lines_deva: प्रतिज्ञातं च रामेण तदा वालिवधं प्रति
lines_iast: pratijñātaṃ ca rāmeṇa tadā vālivadhaṃ prati

words.gloss: with the big toe of his foot

hindi: किन्तु राघव ने विश्वास दिलाने के लिए दुन्दुभि के विशाल शरीर को पैर के अँगूठे से पूरे दस योजन दूर फेंक दिया।
english: But the Rāghava, to inspire confidence, flung the huge body of Dundubhi a full ten yojanas with the big toe of his foot.
notes: uttamam here 'huge/foremost' describing the body; a yojana is a measure of distance (kept as yojana).

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. caus. √jan

hindi: और फिर, विश्वास उत्पन्न करते हुए, उन्होंने तब एक ही महान बाण से सात साल वृक्षों, एक पर्वत और रसातल तक को भेद दिया।
english: And moreover, producing confidence, he then pierced seven sāla trees, a mountain and even Rasātala with a single great arrow.
lines_deva: बिभेद च पुनः सालान् सप्तैकेन महेषुणा
गिरिं रसातलं चैव जनयन् प्रत्ययं तदा
lines_iast: bibheda ca punaḥ sālān saptaikena maheṣuṇā
giriṃ rasātalaṃ caiva janayan pratyayaṃ tadā

hindi: तब उससे प्रसन्नचित्त और विश्वस्त हुआ वह महाकपि राम के साथ किष्किन्धा गुफा को गया।
english: Then that great monkey, glad at heart and made confident by this, went together with Rāma to the cave Kiṣkindhā.
notes: guhām in apposition to kiṣkindhām: Kiṣkindhā is called a cave here.
lines_deva: किष्किन्धां रामसहितो जगाम च गुहां तदा
lines_iast: kiṣkindhāṃ rāmasahito jagāma ca guhāṃ tadā

hindi: तब स्वर्ण के समान पिङ्गल वर्ण वाला हरिश्रेष्ठ सुग्रीव गरजा; उस महान नाद से हरीश्वर बाहर निकल आया।
english: Then Sugrīva, best of monkeys, tawny as gold, roared; at that great roar the lord of monkeys came out.
notes: harīśvaraḥ (the one who came out) is not named in this verse; by context it is the monkey lord inside Kiṣkindhā, whose slaying follows in 55 (Vālin).

hindi: तब सुग्रीव के वचन से युद्ध में वालि को मारकर राघव ने सुग्रीव को ही उस राज्य में स्थापित किया।
english: Then, at Sugrīva's word, having slain Vālin in battle, the Rāghava established Sugrīva himself in that kingdom.

hindi: और वानरश्रेष्ठ ने, जनक-पुत्री को देखने की इच्छा से, सब वानरों को एकत्र करके दिशाओं में भेजा।
english: And he, the bull among monkeys, having gathered all the monkeys, sent them out to the directions, wishing to see the daughter of Janaka.
notes: vānararṣabhaḥ: -rṣabha- after -a- is the printed sandhi of vānara + ṛṣabha (a + ṛ = ar).
lines_deva: स च सर्वान् समानीय वानरान् वानरर्षभः
lines_iast: sa ca sarvān samānīya vānarān vānararṣabhaḥ

hindi: तब गृध्र सम्पाति के वचन से बलवान् हनुमान् ने सौ योजन विस्तृत लवण-समुद्र को लाँघ लिया।
english: Then, at the word of the vulture Sampāti, mighty Hanumat leapt across the salt ocean, a hundred yojanas wide.

hindi: वहाँ रावण द्वारा पालित लङ्का नगरी में पहुँचकर उसने अशोक-वाटिका में गई हुई, चिन्तामग्न सीता को देखा।
english: There, having reached the city of Laṅkā ruled by Rāvaṇa, he saw Sītā, brooding, who had gone to the aśoka grove.
notes: pālitām 'protected/ruled'; aśoka is a tree name, kept as aśoka.

hindi: पहचान का चिह्न देकर और समाचार सुनाकर, तथा वैदेही को आश्वासन देकर, उसने तोरण को तोड़ डाला।
english: Having presented the token of recognition and reported the news, and having consoled the princess of Videha, he smashed the gateway arch.

hindi: पाँच सेनानायकों और सात मन्त्रि-पुत्रों को भी मारकर, तथा वीर अक्ष को कुचलकर, वह बन्दी बनाया गया।
english: Having killed five army leaders and seven sons of ministers too, and having crushed the hero Akṣa, he underwent capture.

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. caus. √mṛṣ

hindi: पितामह के वर के कारण अपने को अस्त्र से मुक्त जानकर, वह वीर अपनी इच्छा से उन बाँधने वाले राक्षसों को सहता रहा।
english: Knowing himself released from the missile by reason of the boon of the Grandsire, the hero, of his own accord, tolerated those rākṣasas who were binding him.

text_flags.why: 'unmuham' is not a Sanskrit word; 'unmuktam' (released) fits sense and the 8-syllable pāda; typing error (ha for kta).

notes: paitāmahād varāt: 'from the Grandsire's boon' = because of the boon granted by Brahmā. Reading unmuktam taken from the flag.

hindi: तब मैथिली सीता को छोड़कर लङ्का नगरी को जलाकर, महाकपि राम को प्रिय समाचार सुनाने के लिए फिर लौट आया।
english: Then, having burnt the city of Laṅkā, except for Sītā the princess of Mithilā, the great monkey came back to tell Rāma the good news.
notes: ṛte governs the accusative here (sītāṃ ca maithilīm): burnt the city but spared Sītā.
lines_deva: ततो दग्ध्वा पुरीं लङ्कामृते सीतां च मैथिलीम्
lines_iast: tato dagdhvā purīṃ laṅkāmṛte sītāṃ ca maithilīm

words.gram: n. acc. sg. (noun; or m. acc. sg. adj. with rāmam)

hindi: अमेय आत्मा वाले उसने महात्मा राम के पास जाकर और उनकी प्रदक्षिणा करके यथार्थ रूप से निवेदन किया — "सीता देख ली गई है।"
english: He, of immeasurable spirit, having approached the great-souled Rāma and circumambulated him, reported truthfully: "Sītā has been seen."

hindi: तब सुग्रीव के साथ महासागर के तट पर जाकर उन्होंने सूर्य के समान बाणों से समुद्र को क्षुब्ध कर दिया।
english: Then, having gone with Sugrīva to the shore of the great ocean, he agitated the sea with arrows resembling the sun.

hindi: और नदियों के स्वामी समुद्र ने स्वयं को प्रकट किया; और समुद्र के वचन से ही उन्होंने नल से सेतु बनवाया।
english: And Samudra, the lord of rivers, showed himself; and at the Ocean's word indeed he had Nala build a causeway.

hindi: उससे लङ्का नगरी में जाकर और युद्ध में रावण को मारकर उन्होंने लङ्का में विभीषण का राक्षसराज के रूप में अभिषेक किया।
english: Having gone by it to the city of Laṅkā and slain Rāvaṇa in battle, he consecrated Vibhīṣaṇa in Laṅkā as lord of the rākṣasas.
notes: tena 'by that' = by the causeway of the previous verse.
lines_deva: तेन गत्वा पुरीं लङ्कां हत्वा रावणमाहवे
lines_iast: tena gatvā purīṃ laṅkāṃ hatvā rāvaṇamāhave

words.gloss: with its moving and unmoving beings
with its hosts of gods and sages

hindi: महात्मा राघव के उस महान कर्म से चर-अचर सहित और देव तथा ऋषियों के समूहों सहित तीनों लोक संतुष्ट हुए।
english: By that great deed of the great-souled Rāghava, the three worlds with their moving and unmoving beings, with their hosts of gods and sages, were pleased.
notes: sadevarṣigaṇam may also be read sa-devarṣi-gaṇam 'with its hosts of divine sages (devarṣi)'.

hindi: इस प्रकार परम संतुष्ट समस्त देवताओं द्वारा पूजित, कृतकृत्य और चिन्तारहित राम तब आनन्दित हुए।
english: Thus, honoured by all the deities, who were supremely pleased, Rāma, his task accomplished and free from anguish, then rejoiced.

hindi: देवताओं से वर पाकर और वानरों को उठाकर, उस पुष्पक पर चढ़कर वे तब नन्दिग्राम गए।
english: Having obtained boons from the deities and raised up the monkeys, he then mounted that Puṣpaka and went to Nandigrāma.
notes: samutthāpya 'having raised up' (the monkeys): the verse does not say from what; literal rendering kept. Puṣpaka is something mounted (samāruhya); the line does not say what it is.
lines_deva: देवताभ्यो वरान् प्राप्य समुत्थाप्य च वानरान्
lines_iast: devatābhyo varān prāpya samutthāpya ca vānarān

words.gram: m. nom. sg., past act. part. ava-√āp

hindi: नन्दिग्राम में जटा को त्यागकर, भाइयों सहित निष्पाप राम ने सीता को पुनः पाकर फिर से राज्य प्राप्त किया।
english: In Nandigrāma, having given up his matted hair, the sinless Rāma, together with his brothers, having regained Sītā, obtained the kingdom again.

hindi: लोग प्रहृष्ट और प्रमुदित, संतुष्ट, पुष्ट, अत्यन्त धार्मिक, रोगरहित और नीरोग तथा दुर्भिक्ष और भय से रहित थे।
english: The people were delighted and joyful, content, well-nourished, very righteous, free from disease and free from sickness, free of famine and fear.

text_flags.why: 'nirāyama' is not a word; 'nirāmaya' (free from disease) is the expected form, paired with aroga; syllables transposed (ya/ma).

notes: 'nirāmayo arogaś' shows unresolved vowel hiatus (o + a) in the edition's own text; kept as printed, not a flag. lokaḥ 'the people/world'; the verse has no finite verb, 'were' supplied. durbhikṣa-bhaya-varjitaḥ may also be read with durbhikṣa-bhaya as a tat-puruṣa: 'free from the fear of famine'. The verse has no verb; 'were' is supplied though 72-76 are future. Since this e-text marks avagraha with an apostrophe elsewhere, 'arogaś' here may be a missing avagraha ('rogaś) rather than a true hiatus; left as printed.

hindi: कोई भी पुरुष कहीं भी पुत्र की मृत्यु नहीं देखेंगे, और स्त्रियाँ सदा अविधवा और पतिव्रता रहेंगी।
english: No men anywhere will see the death of a son; and women will always be unwidowed and devoted to their husbands.
notes: The edition prints 'ke cit' and 'kva cit' as two tokens each; avidhavāḥ loses its visarga before n- (avidhavā nityaṃ).
lines_deva: न पुत्रमरणं के चिद्द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुरुषाः क्व चित्
lines_iast: na putramaraṇaṃ ke ciddrakṣyanti puruṣāḥ kva cit

hindi: वायु से उत्पन्न कोई भय नहीं है, जीव जल में नहीं डूबते, और अग्नि से उत्पन्न भी कोई भय नहीं है; जैसा कृतयुग में था, वैसा ही है।
english: There is no danger at all from wind, creatures do not drown in the waters, and there is no danger at all from fire; as in the Kṛta age, so it is.

text_flags.why: 'agrija' (first-born) gives no sense beside vātajaṃ bhayam; 'agnijam' (born of fire) is the expected parallel; gra/gna typing slip.

notes: Verbless first clauses; 'is' supplied. The surrounding verses are future predictions, but majjanti is present and is translated as such.
lines_deva: न वातजं भयं किं चिन्नाप्सु मज्जन्ति जन्तवः
न चाग्रिजं भयं किं चिद्यथा कृतयुगे तथा
lines_iast: na vātajaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ cinnāpsu majjanti jantavaḥ
na cāgrijaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ cidyathā kṛtayuge tathā

hindi: सैकड़ों अश्वमेधों से तथा बहुसुवर्णक यज्ञों से यज्ञ करके, विद्वानों को विधिपूर्वक करोड़ों और अयुतों गौएँ देकर,
english: Having sacrificed with hundreds of horse sacrifices and likewise with Bahusuvarṇaka rites, having given crores and myriads of cows to the learned according to rite,
notes: Sentence continues into 75 (finite verb sthāpayiṣyati). bahusuvarṇaka: name of a sacrifice characterised by much gold; kept as a name. koṭyayutam: koṭi (ten million) and ayuta (ten thousand), i.e. a vast number; could also be read as 'a koṭi of ayutas'.

hindi: राघव सौ गुने राजवंशों को स्थापित करेंगे, और इस लोक में चारों वर्णों को अपने-अपने धर्म में नियुक्त करेंगे।
english: the Rāghava will establish royal lineages a hundredfold, and in this world he will set the four classes each in its own dharma.
notes: Continues the sentence begun in 74. 'sve sve' repeated = 'each in its own'.
lines_deva: चातुर्वर्ण्यं च लोकेऽस्मिन् स्वे स्वे धर्मे नियोक्ष्यति
lines_iast: cāturvarṇyaṃ ca loke'smin sve sve dharme niyokṣyati

hindi: दस हज़ार वर्ष और दस सौ वर्ष राज्य का पालन करके राम ब्रह्मलोक को जाएँगे।
english: Having ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years and ten hundred years, Rāma will go to the world of Brahmā.
notes: upāsitvā literally 'having attended upon, served' the kingdom, i.e. ruled.

hindi: जो इस पवित्र, पापनाशक, पुण्यमय और वेदों के समान राम-चरित को पढ़ता है, वह सब पापों से मुक्त हो जाता है।
english: Whoever recites this story of Rāma's deeds, purifying, sin-destroying, meritorious and equal to the Vedas, is freed from all sins.
lines_deva: इदं पवित्रं पापघ्नं पुण्यं वेदैश्च सम्मितम्
lines_iast: idaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyaṃ vedaiśca sammitam

hindi: इस आयुवर्धक आख्यान रामायण को पढ़ने वाला मनुष्य पुत्र-पौत्रों और अपने गणों सहित मरने के बाद स्वर्ग में सम्मानित होता है।
english: A man reciting this life-giving narrative, the Rāmāyaṇa, together with sons and grandsons and his retinue, is honoured in heaven after death.
notes: gaṇa 'group, retinue, attendants'; could also be 'kinsfolk'.

hindi: इसे पढ़ने वाला द्विज वाणी में श्रेष्ठता प्राप्त करे; यदि क्षत्रिय हो तो भूमि का स्वामित्व प्राप्त करे; वणिक्-जन व्यापार का फल प्राप्त करे; और शूद्र जन भी महत्ता प्राप्त करे।
english: A twice-born reciting it would attain excellence in speech; should he be a kṣatriya, he would attain lordship of the earth; a merchant would attain profit from his wares; and even a śūdra would attain greatness.

text_flags.why: stray combining mark under the final t (Devanagari has a stray svara mark ॑ after ईयात्); the word is īyāt, a pāda-end mark of the edition's typing, not a letter.
stray combining mark under the final j (same stray ॑ in the Devanagari); īyāt + janaḥ gives īyāj janaḥ by sandhi, so the base letters are right.

notes: Upajāti-type verse (11 syllables a quarter, two quarters per printed line); the stray marks sit at the quarter boundaries. vāgṛṣabhatvam literally 'the state of being a bull (foremost) in speech'. 'syāt' taken as 'if he be'; it could also be a mere optative particle.
